commits.message: fix(extension): prefer raw role module fetch

notes: Chrome initially showed manifest version 5.3.0 until the unpacked extension was reloaded from chrome://extensions.
After reload, manifest showed 5.5.2 and the side panel loaded A2 module generated at 2026-05-12T07:21:23+08:00.
MV3 inline onclick handlers were unreliable, so v5.5.2 binds buttons through popup.js addEventListener.
